# CompactionType

How an interaction summarises older parts of its conversation once it nears the model's context window.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in requests and responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"SameAgent"` | The agent summarises its own conversation. Usually the best summary, since the agent already understands it, but an agent with strict instructions may refuse. |
| `"StandaloneAgent"` | A separate call, without the agent's instructions, writes the summary, so one is always made. It loses the agent's own understanding. |
| `"None"` | No summaries: the conversation is only trimmed. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`InteractionContextSettings`](interaction-context-settings.md)
